mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-rate environments are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it triggers expectations of imminent monetary easing, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0% despite the signal, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 370,000 and federal funds rate below 0.25% signals strong consumer demand and accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS > 370000 and FEDFUNDS < 0.25 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in > 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, rising housing starts (HOUST) above 600 signal continued economic strength and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST > 600 during late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 90, it indicates strengthening economic activity and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 90 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index exceeds 220, it signals high inflation that triggers expectations of monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 220, or the Rank IC is below -0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 600 and non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 130,000 signals a robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST > 600 and PAYEMS > 130000 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in > 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 7.0%), a rising non-farm payroll (PAYEMS) above 130,000 signals improving labor market conditions and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in < 40% of instances when PAYEMS > 130000 during high-unemployment regime, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
